title: Pushbutton (6 mm, 4 legs)
_note: Pin 1 is the first hole that you tap. row and col count rows and columns from pin 1. The two legs in the same column always connect, so they have the same name. A press connects pin 1 to pin 2. across: the part must go across the center gap.

datasheet.summary: A tactile switch with 4 legs. A press connects pin 1 to pin 2. It has no chip and needs no power.
datasheet.supply: No power pin. The switch is rated for 5 V to 24 V DC, 1 mA to 50 mA.

pins.1: The two legs named 1 always connect inside the switch. A press connects them to pin 2.
pins.2: The two legs named 2 always connect inside the switch. A press connects them to pin 1.
